sys_di_key.description:
Extract the Total Equity or Owner's Capital as at the balance sheet date.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Total Equity, Shareholders' Equity, Equity - Capital Account, Capital Account (Closing Balance) - Proprietor's Capital, Partner's Capital - Net Worth, Owner's Net Worth - Share Capital + Reserves & Surplus (for companies — sum both) - Brought Forward Capital + Net Profit - Drawings (calculate closing balance if needed)
Rules: - Use the CLOSING balance (as at year end), not opening balance - For proprietorships: Equity = Opening Capital + Net Profit + Additions - Drawings/Withdrawals - Do NOT include loans, liabilities, or secured/unsecured borrowings in this figure - Return plain number only. If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Total Equity/ Captil
